test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: How many Indian states celebrate their formation on November 1st?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Eight.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer is option 2, which is Eight.
 
• Eight Indian states celebrate their formation on November 1st, which are Andhra Pradesh, Haryana, Karnataka, Kerala, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Tamil Nadu, and Punjab.
 
• Andhra Pradesh was formed on November 1st, 1956, followed by Haryana and Kerala in 1966.
 
• Karnataka was formed on November 1st, 1973, while Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh were created on the same day in 2000.
 
• Punjab was also formed on November 1st, 1966, along with Haryana.
